newsitem.title: UK: BDB has not secured movie rights - paper.
newsitem.headline: BDB has not secured movie rights - paper.

text.p: British Digital Broadcasting (BDB), the consortium awarded the digital terrestrial television franchise last week because of its Sky movie and sports offerings, has not secured the movie rights, the Daily Telegraph said on Tuesday.

The disclosure will again raise questions of the Independent Television Commission's decision to award the licence to BDB, owned by Carlton Communications Plc and Granada Group Plc, over rival Digital Terrestrial Network, owned by NTL Inc, the paper said.

The Premier League, which has an exclusive live four-year deal with Sky, confirmed that BDB has no agreement to show its football matches on digital terrestrial television, the Telegraph said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
